name: MaerzMusik 2026: Cybernetic Entanglements
description: Berlin's premier contemporary music festival returns with 28 concerts across multiple venues including MaHalla, silent green, and Radialsystem. The 2026 edition opens with Georg Friedrich Haas's 11,000 Strings performed on 50 pianos and features 16 world premieres, a tribute to Meredith Monk (recipient of the Berlin Grand Art Prize), and a finale that transforms the Festspielhaus into walk-in sound architecture.
